standard_prerequisites.use: Shows that flatness of the pushforward at the image point is equivalent to flatness of the module at the given point, so the statement upstairs applies.

core_obligations: Reduce to the affine case and embed into an affine space: the question is local, so write the source as the quotient of a polynomial algebra over the base, i.e. choose a closed immersion into an affine space over the base (proof lines 2722-2729).

Apply the finite presentation statement upstairs: push the module forward along the closed immersion and apply the finite presentation version to the projection from the affine space and the pushforward at the image point, obtaining an elementary etale neighbourhood of the base and an open subscheme on which the pushforward is flat (proof lines 2730-2739).

Cut down to the source: intersect that open subscheme with the base change of the source, which contains the unique point lying over the given point and on which the restriction of the pushforward, hence the module itself, is flat over the local base (proof lines 2740-2741).
proof_roadmap: Affine reduction and embedding into an affine space (proof lines 2722-2729).
Apply the finite presentation statement to the pushforward (proof lines 2730-2739).
Intersect with the base change of the source (proof lines 2740-2741).
difficulty_reason: The lemma is the finite type variant of the local structure statement: after an elementary etale neighbourhood of the image point there is an open subscheme of the base change containing the unique point over the given point on which the pullback of the module is flat (statement lines 2700-2720, tag 05I2-adjacent). The proof embeds the source into an affine space over the base, applies the finite presentation version to the pushforward of the module along that closed immersion, and then intersects the resulting open subscheme with the base change of the source. The reduction through the affine space is the substance, so the claim is H2.
